request: Render the public ARGUS Evidence Before Alarm caption-only execution proof. Distinct from the polished local master; no narration, paid APIs or invented incident imagery.

scenes.headline: Evidence before alarm
scenes.body:
Nicholas Kaplan | Independent, AI-assisted research
31 October 2026

scenes.headline: A claim worth testing
scenes.body:
Do more headlines reflect more events?
The reviewed sample cannot establish a worldwide 48-hour surge.

scenes.headline: Make the reasoning visible
scenes.body:
Find the original source.
Separate event time from publication time.
Check direct relevance.

scenes.headline: Three published lenses
scenes.body:
Schelling: commitments (historical).
Aumann: cooperation.
Myerson: incentives.
Frameworks only; no participation or endorsement.

scenes.headline: WHEN verified, THEN act
scenes.body:
A confirmed route restriction prompts a route-specific review.
A claim of an inevitable wider war needs different evidence.

scenes.headline: Look for restoration too
scenes.body: Reopened routes, restored services and agreements that hold can change the assessment.

scenes.headline: Monitoring configured
scenes.body:
Hourly scheduled polling; material changes and corrections only.
Not real-time emergency coverage.

scenes.headline: Evidence invites correction
scenes.body:
Inspect the linked public brief and sources.
Original source. Occurrence date. Relevance.
